title: How CVgen works
tagline: Premium, hand-crafted CVs made with AI on our own Typst `Framework`. Five questions, answered as pictures: what to do with a new `Client`, what happens to a design run, how any change lands, how the parts connect, and who does the work.

snapshot.note: Read from main b83795e, the design-run branch and the Trello board on 2026-10-01. Client data is never shown here: a client is only their `Alias`.

moves.title: Look through the 18 designs in the Design Review app
moves.detail: Optional, any time: mark keep, maybe or reject; agents read your verdicts. You said you would do it later (2026-10-01).

owner.label: You
owner.role: The product owner. The only one who talks to a `Client`, picks the designs and approves a real client's PDF.
notes: Owner-only: `Approval` of a real client's PDF, product decisions, deleting anything under `private/`, replacing the `Release`.
Everything routine (commits, merges to `main`, board updates) is the agents' job.

client.label: The client
client.role: The person the CV is for. Answers the questions, checks the facts in the `Text Draft`, says OK.
notes: Gets at most three messages before `Sign-off`: the question list, one follow-up, the `Text Draft` (plus a corrected draft if asked).
Outside `private/` a client is only their `Alias`, like `client-2026-09-01`.

lead.label: Claude (lead)
lead.role: The main Claude Code session you talk to. Plans, writes, researches, builds, runs the review loops and integrates.
notes: Runs on whatever model the session uses; the repo pins no model for the lead.
Starts every session from the `session-handoff` card on the Trello board and rewrites it before stopping.

magazine-editor.label: magazine-editor
magazine-editor.role: Art director. Draws three very distinct `Styles`, each in two `Densities` and three `Design Tiers`: 18 real Typst mock-ups on fictional data.
magazine-editor.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, PowerShell, WebSearch, WebFetch, Write, Edit
magazine-editor.access: Writes only its concept folders, the concepts README and fonts. Never git, Trello or `private/`.
magazine-editor.when: A design run, for inspiration or for a client whose `Domain` has no `Template` yet.
notes: The two `Densities` (18 designs per run) were added on 2026-09-29 on the run branch `docs/idea-run-2026-09-29-editor`; `main` still says nine pages until that run merges.

design-reviewer.label: design-reviewer
design-reviewer.role: Art-direction gate. Judges every page on the `Batch Test`, the `Three-Second Test` and `Flagship Parity` first; any of those failing is Blocking.
design-reviewer.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, PowerShell, WebFetch
design-reviewer.calledBy: The lead: a fresh one every round.
design-reviewer.when: Design runs, client designs, Flagship changes, brand assets.
notes: Rubric: 1 `Batch Test`, 2 `Three-Second Test`, 3 `Flagship Parity`, 4 distinct, 5 reads as a CV, 6 craft, 7 provenance, 8 buildable and honest.
Makes batch sheets: each page shrunk among 8+ plain market CVs.

research-reviewer.label: research-reviewer
research-reviewer.role: Checks that every source exists, is current and says what is claimed.
research-reviewer.calledBy: The lead: a fresh one every round.
research-reviewer.when: A design run's references, a client's `Deep Dives`, `Research Library` notes.
notes: Never reads `private/`: the lead passes client research inline, checked for client details, with its SHA-256.

ceo.label: ceo
ceo.role: Product strategist. Proposes at most three researched product ideas as pending proposals.
ceo.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, WebSearch, WebFetch, Write, Edit
ceo.access: Writes only in its run folder. No shell.
ceo.when: A product `Idea Run`, weekly at most.

ceo-reviewer.label: ceo-reviewer
ceo-reviewer.role: Judges each product idea: real need, fit, honest smallest version, not a duplicate, decision-ready.

code-reviewer.label: code-reviewer
code-reviewer.role: The independent review gate for every non-trivial change. Fresh context, eight lenses, verdict PASS or FINDINGS.
code-reviewer.calledBy: The lead: a fresh one every round, never a fork, never self-review.
code-reviewer.when: Code, tests, fixtures, and on `main` every other change no other gate covers.
notes: May rerun vetted checks that write only under `builds/`.
Opus at high is the owner's standing choice for reviewers (since 2026-09-26).

repo-auditor-lite.label: repo-auditor-lite
repo-auditor-lite.role: Read-only repository auditor with no shell. Does the judgement checks after the audit script ran.
notes: Inherits the session's model at medium effort: fine, it never gives a review verdict.

context-reviewer.label: context-reviewer
context-reviewer.role: Review gate for agent context: AGENTS.md, docs rules, glossary, skills, agent files. Checks placement, terms and that no client leaks.
context-reviewer.when: Any change to the files agents read.
notes: Built on branch `docs/codex-visual-tools`, not merged, and its own review there is FINDINGS. On `main` the review gate is still `code-reviewer`; agent-context changes have been reviewed by a general-purpose stand-in told to act as this file.

context-maintainer.label: context-maintainer
context-maintainer.role: Puts your feedback into the one file that owns the rule. Consolidates, never appends.
context-maintainer.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, PowerShell
context-maintainer.when: Feedback from you that changes how agents behave.
notes: Exists only on branch `docs/codex-visual-tools` (not merged).

general-purpose.label: general-purpose
general-purpose.role: Claude Code's built-in agent. Writes each `Deep Dive`, can run the `Scout`, and stands in for any agent file not loaded yet.
notes: As a stand-in it is told to act exactly as the agent file, with that file's tools as a hard limit, and the lead records its model and effort.

codex-reviewer.label: codex-visual-reviewer
codex-reviewer.role: Second visual reviewer beside the design-reviewer: looks at the page images through the Codex CLI. A design round passes only when both pass.
codex-reviewer.calledBy: The lead, every design round (once built).
notes: Approved by you on 2026-09-29, not built. The proposal has two open Material findings: run with `--ephemeral` and `--ignore-user-config`.

codex-image.label: Codex image step
codex-image.role: Generates raster images a design commissions: never a portrait, no real people, brands or text, at most two per page.
codex-image.calledBy: The magazine-editor commissions images; the lead does for client designs (once built).
notes: Approved 2026-09-29, not built.

new-client.label: new-client
new-client.role: Checklist from a client's first message to signed-off facts: `Envelope`, `Intake`, research, `Text Draft`, `Sign-off`.
new-client.when: You say a new client arrived, or ask to continue their intake or research.
notes: Every time it runs it also checks for stalled clients (3 months, no `Export`) and passed delete-by dates.

new-cv.label: new-cv
new-cv.role: Checklist that builds the CV itself: data, entry point, page plan, the client design loop, the render and its evidence.
new-cv.when: After `Sign-off`, or to add a public example.

idea-run.label: idea-run
idea-run.role: Runs an idea agent (magazine-editor or ceo) in a closed review loop. Authors propose, reviewers judge, you decide.
idea-run.when: You ask for design concepts, template inspiration or product ideas.

verify-cv.label: verify-cv
verify-cv.role: Runs the full suite and reads its evidence.

new-theme.label: new-theme
new-theme.role: Adds a `Theme` or `Artwork Pack` and proves the `Frozen Reference` is untouched.
new-theme.when: A new look, colour scheme or role illustrations.

trello.label: trello
trello.role: Reads and updates the CVgen board through its REST API. Every task's record is a card.
trello.when: Orientation, and every task state change.

repo-maintenance.label: repo-maintenance
repo-maintenance.role: Keeps the tree easy to navigate: a read-only audit (`quick`, `audit`, `deep`), then `apply` moves only what you approved by ID.
repo-maintenance.when: `quick` in every `Session Sweep`; the rest when you ask for a tidy-up.

night-shift.label: Night Shift skills
night-shift.role: Unattended overnight work (`start-night-shift`) and its follow-up by day (`do-night-shift-follow-up`).

cv-py.label: scripts/cv.py
cv-py.role: `render`, `approve`, `export`, `status` for one client's `Envelope`. Each render is a new `Revision`; it never overwrites.
notes: Exit 1: compile or checks failed, the `Revision` is kept. Exit 2: refused, nothing written.

outputs-py.label: scripts/outputs.py
outputs-py.role: The `Output Contract` tool: `stamp` writes a PDF's `Meta File`; `check` lists every PDF without a valid one.

suite.label: tests/run.py
suite.role: The full test suite: compiles every example, checks the `Frozen Reference` pixel for pixel, the workflow, the contract. Evidence goes to `builds/tests-<timestamp>/`.

design-review-app.label: Design Review app
design-review-app.role: Your local app for looking through designs: the Board (`Style` × `Density` × `Design Tier`), the Loupe, compare, a `Batch Test` pile, your verdicts and notes.
notes: `python scripts/design_review/server.py`, then http://127.0.0.1:8765/. Binds to this machine only.
Your verdicts (keep / maybe / reject) live in `.local/design-review/state.json`.

build-ps1.label: scripts/build.ps1
build-ps1.role: Builds the five public examples into `builds/`; with `-Release` it copies them beside their entry points and stamps them.

intake-form.label: Intake Form script
intake-form.role: Google Apps Script you run once per form: builds the optional `Intake Form` and its answers Sheet in your Google account.

board.label: Trello board "CVgen"
board.role: The task store. Lists: Handoff, Queued, Active, Review, Ready, Done. The `session-handoff` card is where every session starts.

chat.label: Chat app
chat.role: Viber, WhatsApp or email: how you pass questions and drafts to the client and bring answers back.

github-ci.label: GitHub CI
github-ci.role: Runs the suite on every push and pull request (Typst 0.15.1). The lead watches it on `main` before calling work Done.

terms.CVgen: The product: premium, hand-crafted CVs built with AI on our own Typst `Framework`.
terms.Framework: The shared Typst core every CV is built on: page frame, headings, data merge, checks. Knows no `Domain`.
terms.Domain: A career area with its own facts shape, wording, artwork and rules: Marine, Travel & Tourism. Ids: `marine`, `travel`.
terms.Role: One specialisation inside a `Domain`, never a fork: Deck and Engine in Marine.
terms.Rank: The client's job title: second engineer, captain, tour guide.
terms.Template: A named CV design. Belongs to a `Domain`, or lives in one `Envelope` as a one-off for a single client.
terms.Flagship: The marine `Template`: the quality bar every design is measured against.
terms.Theme: A `Template`'s colours, fonts and sizes only.
terms.Artwork Pack: Which illustration goes in which slot of a `Template`.
terms.Client: The person a CV is for, who also pays for it. The code says "candidate".
terms.Envelope: One client's private folder: facts, portrait, `Template` tweaks, every `Revision` and `Export`. Lives in `private/`, never in Git.
terms.Alias: The neutral name for a client outside `private/`: client-yyyy-mm-nn.
terms.Intake: Collecting a client's facts and goals before research: a question list sent by chat, answers kept in the `Envelope`.
terms.Relay: The `Intake` method: Claude writes the questions, you pass them to the client by chat and bring the answers back.
terms.Intake Form: The `Relay` questions as an optional, designed Google Form, made by running a per-form Apps Script.
terms.Research Library: Shared, dated research notes about a country, `Domain` or `Rank`, reused across clients, rechecked after 6 months. No client data.
terms.Scout: A wide, shallow first search for one client: the `Research Library` first, the web for what is missing.
terms.CV Decisions: The choices a CV must make (title, length, photo, language, `Template`, what leads), each sourced, a judgement, or open.
terms.Deep Dive: One agent researching one open question, chosen by you after the `Scout`.
terms.Text Draft: The CV's content as a PDF in the fixed house design (First Fitting) that the client checks before design starts.
terms.Check Page: Page 1 of a `Text Draft`, in the client's language (the house copy is Greek): check only the underlined facts, reply OK.
terms.Fact Mark: The copper stitch under a fact the client must check in a `Text Draft`.
terms.Sign-off: The client's "OK, the facts are correct" on the `Text Draft`, before design starts. Usually a chat message, screenshot kept.
terms.Revision: One render of a CV in its own folder, never overwritten.
terms.Approval: Your act on one exact PDF, bound to its SHA-256. Agents never approve a real client's PDF.
terms.Export: The verified copy of a client's approved PDF, ready to deliver.
terms.Release: The public example PDFs that show the product, with fictional people.
terms.Output Contract: Every PDF we show sits in its kind's one home and carries a `Meta File`.
terms.Meta File: The small JSON beside a PDF saying what it is (kind, `Domain`, status, pages) with its SHA-256.
terms.Frozen Reference: The PDF a `Template`'s public example must reproduce pixel for pixel.
terms.Framework Gap: A recorded case of going around the `Framework`, a `Domain` or a `Template` to deliver a CV.
terms.Session Sweep: The places to look for loose ends before a session ends: unreviewed commits, approved proposals, open cards, Night Shift items, Git leftovers, CI, `builds/`.
terms.Certificate Warning: A WARNING line at render: a certificate expired or expires within 180 days. Never blocks.
terms.Live Read: A render that read a private file directly instead of the `Revision`'s copy. It fails its checks.
terms.Batch Test: Design test 1: in an HR batch of 100 to 200 CVs, ours cannot be skipped.
terms.Three-Second Test: Design test 2: before a word is read, the page shouts its `Domain`, specialty and role.
terms.Flagship Parity: Design test 3: side by side with the Marine Flagship, the CV looks as confident and premium.
terms.Style: One idea of a magazine-editor run. A run has three very distinct ones.
terms.Design Tier: Safe (calm, never generic), Stylish (Flagship territory), Creative (style to the maximum).
terms.Density: Condensed (one dense page) or Spacious (1 to 3 roomier pages). Every `Style` is drawn in both. Added 2026-09-29 on the run branch; reaches `main` with the run.
terms.Anti-example: A design you rejected as not your style, kept frozen only so nobody proposes its idea again.
terms.Design Review: Your local app for looking through designs and recording verdicts.
terms.Idea Run: One closed loop of an idea agent (ceo or magazine-editor) and its reviewers.

modelNotes.Session model: Whatever model your Claude Code session runs; the repo pins none. Today: Opus 5.5.
modelNotes.Opus: The `opus` alias in the agent files: the newest Opus, today Opus 5.5.
